title: Megtorlás és a forradalom öröksége (Retribution, Exile & Reburial (1989))
grammar: Directives of Freedom, Asymmetric Warfare & Sovereign Historical Discourse

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what happened to the revolutionaries after 1956.
I can say what the megtorlás and the emigráció were.
I can say what the reburial of Imre Nagy in 1989 was.
I can use six words about the aftermath, such as megtorlás and újratemetés.
